newsitem.title: USA: Rogers Cantel stake cut by Quebec agency.
newsitem.headline: Rogers Cantel stake cut by Quebec agency.

text.p: Caisse de depot du Quebec said Tuesday it reduced its stake in Rogers Cantel Mobile Communications Inc to 1,574,407 Class B subordinate shares or 8.38 percent from 10.25 percent held on October 18.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the investment agency said its latest transactions include the sale of 257,000 shares between December 6 and December 19 at prices ranging from C$26.15 to C$28.96 per share.
The shares were sold in the Canadian company for investment purposes, the filing said.
Rogers Cantel of North York, Ontario, operates a cellular telephone network in Canada and offers a full range of wireless communication services including paging, voice and data.
